name: Kartra
summary: Platform for selling online: landing pages, email automation, funnels, memberships and checkout in one tool, with no plugins to stitch together.
best_for: creators and coaches who want funnels, email, checkout, memberships and scheduling under one roof instead of five subscriptions
skip_if: you only need one of those pieces: a dedicated tool does that piece better and cheaper than a suite; or you want to run webinars inside it: Kartra's own help centre says that from 1 November 2026 you can no longer create or edit webinars (read 28 September 2026), and Kartra told its affiliates the feature is removed entirely on 1 December 2026, even though the pricing page still names Webinars as a Starter feature
honest_knock: If your core need is polished course delivery, Kajabi's creator features are stronger; Kartra wins on breadth, not course depth.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, or $52 a month billed yearly

plans.name: Essentials
plans.includes: 500 contacts, 5% transaction fee, 10,000 emails/texts, 1 custom domain

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-05 and again 2026-09-30 on their own pricing page) Four tiers, monthly against yearly: Essentials $59 / $52, Starter $119 / $99, Growth $229 / $189 and Professional $549 / $429, with yearly billing advertised as saving up to 22% and a 14-day trial. The tier names moved since our August reading — the $119 plan is now called Starter and the $229 plan Growth — while every amount stayed the same. The line that changes the arithmetic and is missing from most summaries: Essentials charges a 5% transaction fee on your sales, and the tiers above it charge 0%. On $10,000 a month of sales that fee is $500, which makes the $60 step from Essentials to Starter trivially worth taking. Contacts are capped at 500, 2,500, 12,500 and 25,000 across the four tiers; Essentials sends 10,000 emails and texts a month against unlimited above it and includes 1 custom domain. Kartra never blocks new leads: it upgrades you automatically to the tier that fits and charges a mid-cycle reconciliation fee for the move — two answers above that one, the same FAQ says a Kartra subscription is flat-rate and there are never any extra fees. On 30 September 2026 all eight amounts were unchanged, and the page now opens with a 30-day money-back guarantee and cancel-anytime line above the plan toggle.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Kartra in the Essentials trial that we started with our card. Billing shows a 30-day trial and USD 71.39 a month after it, which is the $59 price plus 21 percent VAT. A draft page from a template took about 1 minute 25 seconds, but helpdesks and calendars are locked on Essentials. Cancelling took 3 steps with a 50% offer and stopped the account at once. Account and start: we created the account and started the Essentials trial with his own card; he also typed the password and secret question himself when the app asked for them. Our AI assistant ran the rest in our browser on 19 November 2026 from 16:37 to 16:43 CET. Setup asked for a business address (A valid physical mailing address is required for emails sent for business purposes by the CAN-SPAM Act.) and a tick box for the Terms of Service and DPA; we entered a company name and a test street. Setting up took about 25 seconds. No phone number and no code were asked. The interface was in English. Core action, the marketing parts: Pages offers 669 results in the template library. A page from a template, named Test Draft Page, opened in the builder after about 6 seconds and is listed as Draft, NOT PUBLISHED YET; from dashboard to draft page took about 1 minute 25 seconds and 6 clicks. Nothing was published. A list was created after a required public description: Your list has been created! A sequence opened in the Sequence builder with blocks for email and SMS, tags, lists, splits and waits; no mail was sent. A product opened in Demo mode with PayPal and Test credit card, and the list says Your product is unpublished, it won't be accessible, and it won't process any sales. No checkout and no form were built. Helpdesks and Calendars are locked on Essentials: To unlock this option, upgrade your plan. Contacts Analytics showed Total contacts 1. Plans and trial: Billing, My payment plans: Last bill Essentials USD 0.00 19 Nov 2026 and Next bill Essentials USD 71.39 19 Dec 2026, so the trial runs 30 days. Meters: contacts 0 of 500, AI uses 0 of 100, emails 0 of 1000. The plan cards say Taxes included: Essentials USD 71.39, Starter USD 143.99, Growth USD 277.09, Professional USD 664.29 a month. The Essentials card lists Transaction fee 5% of sales and 5 published pages. The billing address is in the Netherlands, so 21 percent VAT is added. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen; we reported To pay today USD 0.00. Cancelling, done the same day: Billing, the red Cancel on the Essentials card. Step 1, Wait! Exclusive Offer.: 50% off the first payment if you stay; declined with No, thank you. Step 2, Cancel account: Freeze my account or Cancel my account; we chose Cancel my account. Step 3: a tick box, I understand that, by cancelling my trial now, my subscription will be deactivated and no longer renew. My account assets (pages, products, memberships, etc) will stop functioning., two required questions and a text box. Then Confirm. After a reload Billing showed Account inactive. No password and no support contact. Not tested: building a form or checkout, webinars, the AI writing help, sending real mail, a custom domain, a payment processor and the helpdesk itself. Clean up: the draft page, the list, the sequence and the demo product stay; the account is inactive. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app asked for a password and secret question before the first use. The plan cards show prices with tax, so they differ from the pricing page. Cancelling in the trial stops pages and products at once, and the Freeze my account option sits next to Cancel my account.

open_questions.question: Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
